extras: Warns that OAuth credentials and tokens are stored unencrypted in data.json and should be kept out of source control and device syncing; the release is pending marketplace review and must be installed manually or via BRAT; the custom-scheme OAuth callback still requires live verification, with a manual HTTPS callback fallback.
problem: Oura health data lives in the Oura app and cloud API, so it is not available inside Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: Enable community plugins and install Obsidian42 - BRAT
